The Colt Model 1908 Vest Pocket is a small, hammerless semi-automatic pistol produced by Colt’s Manufacturing Company from 1908 to 1948. Chambered in .25 ACP, this pocket-sized pistol was designed for discreet concealed carry, often fitting easily into a vest pocket, as its name suggests. Designed by John Browning, the Model 1908 features a simple blowback action and a six-round magazine. Its compact size, combined with reliable performance and quality Colt craftsmanship, made it a popular choice for personal defense during the early 20th century.
